description: Domain registration facts via RDAP (IANA bootstrap, then the registry's own server): registration, last change and expiry dates, days left, registrar name, status flags, nameservers and DNSSEC delegation flag. Registrant contact data is usually redacted by registries and is not returned. Choose this tool for: Domain registration facts via RDAP: registration, last. Close alternatives on this server: security_abuseipdb_check (AbuseIPDB reputation for an IPv4 address over the last 90); security_bimi_record_audit (Reads a domain's BIMI record: whether it is published). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_whois_rdap
